input: Draft talking points for my next performance review

gold.taskTitle: Draft Talking Points for My Performance Review
gold.taskDescription: Prepare a set of focused, persuasive talking points the user can bring to their upcoming performance review.

questions.title: What is your current role and industry?
questions.description: Understanding the user's job title and field ensures the talking points use the right language and context.

questions.title: What specific outcome do you want from this review?
questions.description: Clarifies whether the user is aiming for a promotion, raise, expanded responsibilities, better feedback, or something else.

questions.title: What are your two or three biggest accomplishments since your last review?
questions.description: Identifies the concrete wins and results that should anchor the talking points.

questions.title: Are there any challenges or weaknesses you need to address proactively?
questions.description: Determines whether the user needs to frame setbacks, gaps, or critical feedback in a constructive way.

questions.title: What metrics or evidence can you point to for your work?
questions.description: Establishes whether there are numbers, project outcomes, or other measurable proof points available to strengthen claims.

questions.title: How does your manager typically respond to direct self-advocacy?
questions.description: Helps calibrate the tone, from assertive and data-driven to collaborative and development-focused.

questions.title: When is the review scheduled, and how much time do you have?
questions.description: Sets the deadline so the plan and effort level can be scoped appropriately.
